note: `pulse` is [M]'s π(E) (positivity is `pulse_positive`), and `up`, `weighted` carry the weight π(E)dμ; positivity of the pushforwards is by construction.

lemma two_average (x : Space3) (h : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, 0 ≤ p timeAxis) (hp : ∀ᵐ p ∂ν, 0 ≤ p timeAxis) :
    averaged (fun p => charFun μ p - charFun ν (-p)) x =
      charFun ((weighted μ).map spatial) x + charFun ((weighted ν).map (fun p => -spatial p)) x := by
  have he : charFun ((weighted ν).map (fun p => -spatial p)) x = charFun ((weighted ν).map spatial) (-x) := by
    rw [charFun_apply,charFun_apply,integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      integral_map rest_cont.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]; simp
  rw [he,← one_average μ x h,← one_average ν (-x) hp]
  unfold averaged
  rw [← integral_add (intervalChar μ x) (intervalChar ν (-x))]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
  have hh (t) : -(position x t)=position (-x) (-t) := by apply Mink.ext_by <;> simp
  simp only [oddTest]; rw [hh,hh,neg_neg]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: The time average `averaged` of the odd part of `charFun μ p - charFun ν (-p)` is the sum of the Fourier transforms of the pushforwards of `weighted μ` under `spatial` and `weighted ν` under `-spatial`, with weight `up p = pulse (time p)`.

lemma pulse_lower {t : ℝ} (hx : t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : t/Real.pi ≤ pulse t := by
  have ht := hx.2
  have hp := hx.1
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2/Real.pi*t)*x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)
        ((show Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (2/Real.pi*t)*x) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable ..)
        ((show Continuous (fun u => Real.sin (t*u)) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable ..)
      intro x h
      have he := h.1
      have hh : t*x ≤ Real.pi/2 := (mul_le_one₀ ht he h.2).trans (by linarith [Real.two_le_pi])
      rw [mul_assoc]; exact Real.mul_le_sin (mul_nonneg hp he) hh

proof_context.conclusion: `pulse t = ∫_0^1 sin (t x) dx = (1-cos t)/t` satisfies `t/π ≤ pulse t` on `[0,1]`.

lemma averaged_bound (M : ℝ) (h : μ.real univ + ν.real univ ≤ M) (x : Space3) :
    ‖averaged A x‖ ≤ M := by
  have hh p : ‖A p‖ ≤ M := (norm_sub_le ..).trans ((add_le_add (norm_charFun_le _) (norm_charFun_le _)).trans h)
  have ht t : ‖oddTest (fun t => A (position x t)) t‖ ≤ M := by
    rw [oddTest,norm_div,norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,mul_one,show ‖(2:ℂ)‖=(2:ℝ) by simp,div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    exact (norm_sub_le ..).trans ((add_le_add (hh _) (hh _)).trans_eq (mul_two M).symm)
  have hc := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ:=volume.restrict (Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (integrable_const _) (ae_of_all _ ht)
  unfold averaged; simpa using hc

proof_context.conclusion: `‖averaged A x‖ ≤ M` when the two total masses sum to at most `M`.

theorem late (w : SumOfWords S) (h : finite w) : ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ i, ∀ x : Space3, R < ‖x‖ →
    averaged (delta (L.actors i) w) x=0 := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := distant _ _ (fin_reverse F.action.J h) h F.action.spin
  refine ⟨R,fun i x hx => ?_⟩
  have he t (ht : |t| ≤ 1) : delta (L.actors i) w (position x t)=0 := by
    rw [comm_expect (L.cores i) F.sector.derivatives F.room.kernel.laws.toSymmetric F.phase.transport.injection]
    have hh : spacelikeWords (reverseP (L.actors i).J w) (acted (L.actors i).spin (Poincare.translation (position x t)) w) := by
      rw [L.spins,L.letters]; exact hR t ht x hx
    rw [op_comm (L.actors i).operators (L.cores i).localPairs hh,sub_self]
  refine setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y hy => ?_)
  have hp : |y| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hy.1.le]; exact hy.2
  simp only [oddTest, he y hp, he (-y) (by simpa using hp), sub_self, zero_div]

proof_context.conclusion: `averaged (delta ..) x = 0` for `R < ‖x‖`, so the time average is supported in the closed ball of radius `R`.
